notablePrerequisites: You have at least four permanent cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Vineweft, untapping The Core.
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Vineweft by paying {4}{G}, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.name: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core
uses.cardState: on the battlefield as The Core
